findings.evidence: Lines 147–149 quantify over every positive `lambda`, while `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/OneParameterSemigroups/README.md:126,153` specifies `∃ λ₀ > 0` on a Banach space. The surrounding variables at Basic.lean:65 assume only `NormedAddCommGroup` and `NormedSpace`.
findings.fix: Define the range condition existentially, then separately prove the all-positive-`λ` consequence under `CompleteSpace X`; the generator theorem can supply the existential witness directly.
findings.issue: `IsMDissipative` requires surjectivity of `λI-A` for every positive `λ`; the natural Lumer–Phillips hypothesis is surjectivity for some positive `λ₀`, and this definition does not even assume `CompleteSpace X`, which the usual upgrade argument needs.

summary: The public m-dissipativity predicate imposes a stronger-than-natural universal range condition, even on incomplete normed spaces where the claimed equivalence is unavailable.
